# Agencia Tributaria - Sede Electrónica

> Official digital headquarters of Spain's Tax Agency (Agencia Tributaria) providing comprehensive tax services, declarations, and electronic administration for individual and business taxpayers.

The Agencia Tributaria's electronic office (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es) is the primary digital portal for Spanish taxpayers to manage tax obligations, access personal accounts, file declarations, and access regulatory information. The site supports multiple languages (Spanish, Catalan, Galician, Valencian, Basque, and English) and integrates digital identification systems like Cl@ve and DNI electrónico for secure access.

## Key Topics

- IRPF (Impuesto sobre la Renta de Personas Físicas)
- IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
- Impuesto sobre Sociedades
- Agencia Tributaria
- Cl@ve (digital authentication)
- DNI electrónico (electronic ID)
- SII (Sistema Inmediato de Información)
- VERI*FACTU (invoice verification)
- IAE (Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas)
- APP-AEAT (Tax Agency mobile app)
- Tax declarations
- Electronic services
- Taxpayer calendar
- Digital identification
- Tax regulations

## Main Portal & Personal Services

- [Agencia Tributaria: Inicio](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es): Spanish Tax Agency homepage with tax declarations, IRPF, VAT, and digital services.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Inicio](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/inicio.html): Spanish Tax Agency main portal for tax services and online declarations.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Mi área personal](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/mi-area-personal.html): Personal tax account access with electronic authentication and document management.

## Multilingual Access

- [Agència Tributària: Inici (Catalan)](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/ca_es/inicio.html): Tax Agency homepage in Catalan with IRPF, VAT, and digital services.
- [Axencia Tributaria: Inicio (Galician)](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/gl_es/inicio.html): Tax Agency homepage in Galician with income tax and VAT services.
- [Agència Tributària: Inici (Valencian)](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/va_es/inicio.html): Tax Agency homepage in Valencian with IRPF and digital tax services.
- [Zerga Agentzia: Hasiera (Basque)](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/eu_es/inicio.html): Tax Agency homepage in Basque with income tax and VAT management.
- [Tax Agency: Home (English)](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/en_gb/inicio.html): Spanish Tax Agency homepage in English with tax procedures and digital services.

## Tax Regulations & Reference

- [Agencia Tributaria: Normativa y criterios interpretativos](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/normativa-criterios-interpretativos.html): Tax regulations, legal framework, and interpretive criteria for Spanish taxes.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Calendario, fecha y hora oficial](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/Calendario_fecha_y_hora_oficial.html): Official tax calendar, deadlines, and administrative procedures for Spanish taxpayers.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Estadísticas](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/estadisticas.html): Tax statistics, revenue collection data, and fiscal analysis reports.

## Institutional Information

- [Agencia Tributaria: Información institucional](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/informacion-institucional.html): Institutional information about Agencia Tributaria organization and annual accounts.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Gobierno abierto](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/gobierno-abierto.html): Open government initiative with transparency portal and public participation.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Planificación](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/planificacion.html): Strategic planning and performance evaluation for Tax Agency 2024-2027.

## Optional

- [Agencia Tributaria: Trabajar en la Agencia Tributaria](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/trabajar-agencia-tributaria.html): Job opportunities and recruitment processes for Tax Agency employment.
- [Agencia Tributaria: Perfil del contratante](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/perfil-contratante.html): Government contracting profile and public procurement information.
